requirement: Describe the Phase III multicenter open-label active-controlled randomized pediatric VTE study comparing body-weight-adjusted rivaroxaban with standard anticoagulation.

evidence.text: The protocol identifies the design, population, and treatment comparison.

requirement: Specify central 2:1 randomization to rivaroxaban versus comparator, stratified within age groups by baseline VTE presentation.

evidence.text: The SAP describes the central allocation ratio and stratification.

requirement: Define the primary efficacy outcome as centrally adjudicated symptomatic recurrent venous thromboembolism during the subject-specific main treatment period.

evidence.text: The SAP identifies the primary efficacy outcome and blinded central adjudication.

requirement: Include symptomatic recurrent VTE plus asymptomatic worsening on repeat imaging as the secondary efficacy outcome and preserve the ordered thrombotic-burden imaging categories.

evidence.text: The SAP defines the secondary efficacy composite and imaging outcomes.

requirement: Define the principal safety outcome as centrally adjudicated overt major plus clinically relevant non-major bleeding.

evidence.text: The SAP names the principal safety composite.

requirement: Define FAS as all randomized children and bind the principal efficacy descriptions to randomized treatment; also present SAF and PPS support as prespecified.

evidence.text: The SAP defines populations and uses all three for efficacy reporting.

requirement: Define SAF as randomized children receiving at least one study-medication dose and use it for treatment-emergent safety and bleeding analyses.

evidence.text: The SAP defines SAF and safety analysis use.

requirement: Present primary efficacy incidence proportions and cumulative incidence/Kaplan-Meier summaries with two-sided 95% confidence intervals; do not label the study as a powered confirmatory non-inferiority test.

evidence.text: The SAP specifies descriptive estimates and explains that a feasible pediatric NI trial is not powered.

requirement: Use exploratory Cox proportional-hazards models stratified by CVST, CVC-VTE, and non-CVC-VTE with Firth penalization for sparse events; report hazard ratios, profile-likelihood intervals, and p-values only when estimable.

evidence.text: The SAP defines exploratory sparse-event Cox analyses.

requirement: Apply the age-specific main-treatment windows: Day 30 plus or minus 7 for children under two with CVC-VTE and Day 90 plus or minus 7 for other children, with the SAP-defined event and censoring cutoffs.

evidence.text: The SAP gives age/presentation-specific main-period and censoring definitions.

requirement: Implement the prespecified repeat-imaging imputation categories and document missingness and premature discontinuation by treatment rather than silently treating unavailable imaging as unchanged.

evidence.text: The SAP contains explicit missing-date, repeat-imaging, and dropout rules.

requirement: Assess informative dropout for recurrent VTE with scenarios assigning post-dropout hazards 1.5 and 2 times the estimated within-treatment hazard.

evidence.text: The SAP defines two informative-missingness hazard scenarios.

requirement: State the feasible enrollment target as at least 170 children with age-cohort minima and explain that it supports descriptive efficacy, safety, PK, and PD rather than formal non-inferiority power.

evidence.text: The SAP gives cohort targets and feasibility rationale.

requirement: Treat between-group models, risk differences, imaging comparisons, and subgroup analyses as exploratory, with no familywise confirmatory claim or multiplicity-protected hierarchy.

evidence.text: The SAP repeatedly labels comparative models exploratory and defines no confirmatory hierarchy.

requirement: Summarize treatment-emergent AEs through two days after last dose, AESIs, laboratory abnormalities, and adjudicated bleeding by age and treatment, separating later post-treatment events.
